title: metrics rsp
description: Response to cmd:metrics. Describes what MetricsRegistry::snapshot_json (backend/include/xi/xi_metrics.hpp) ACTUALLY emits into data: top-level frames_total/frames_ok/frames_error counters plus an inspect_compute_ms block (count/sum_ms/mean_ms and a `buckets` ARRAY of {le,count}). The array has one entry per fixed edge (0.5,1,2,5,10,20,50,100,200,500,1000,2000,5000) followed by a final overflow entry whose `le` is the STRING "inf" — hence `le` is number-or-string. The bucket counts partition frames_total. (An earlier fixture modelled buckets as a fixed-key object le_1..gt_50 and omitted the frame counters; that never matched the backend and is corrected here.)
